items.stem: What does the AWS Glue Data Catalog provide?

options.text: A central metadata store of table definitions and schemas for your data
options.rationale: Correct: the Data Catalog holds table and schema metadata.

options.text: The physical storage of the data itself
options.rationale: Data stays in S3; the catalog stores metadata.
It is a metadata catalog, not a database engine.
It is not a billing tool.

items.explanation: Correct: the Data Catalog is a central metadata store.

items.stem: What is the main governance advantage of Lake Formation over S3 bucket policies alone?

options.text: Fine-grained table- and column-level access control
options.rationale: Correct: Lake Formation adds table/column-level permissions.
Lake Formation is about governance, not storage price.
Schema inference is a crawler function.
It does not change network throughput.

items.explanation: Correct: Lake Formation enables fine-grained access control.

items.stem: Which TWO practices improve data-lake query performance and cost? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Store data in a columnar format such as Parquet
options.rationale: Correct: columnar formats cut scan cost.

options.text: Partition data by a commonly filtered key

options.rationale: Uncompressed CSV scans more data and costs more.

options.text: Reprocess all data on every run

items.explanation: Correct: columnar formats and partitioning cut scan cost.
